# Tests of the whole suite that fail on Windows (windows-latest, Python 3.12) and are KNOWN: first listed on 11.11.2026 from the
# run of commit bf71daf (CI run 42927533093, job "tests-os (windows-latest)", command
#   PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m unittest discover -s tests -v ).
# The "Windows suite" workflow lists them apart from any new failure but stays RED while any test fails: Windows is
# UNCONFIRMED until this file is empty. Causes seen: files still open when replaced (WinError 32/5) and POSIX-only
# assumptions in the guard and the output tests. Each is a defect of its own, not fixed by the CI work.
# One test id per line (module.Class.method); remove a line when its test passes.
# 11.11.2026: the four test_batch_integrity entries were removed. They failed with WinError 5/32 because the test helper left a read-only
# workbook open (freed only by the garbage collector, so the result followed the composition of the suite); the helper now closes it.
# 11.11.2026: six entries removed (test_run_log_times_resolve, test_output_layer, test_audit_evidence). Windows path separators: the `digests`
# helpers returned keys with a backslash and three messages are printed with the platform separator, while the tests expected a slash.
# 11.11.2026: the seven test_guard_destructive entries were removed. The guard is a POSIX hook (scripts/guard_destructive.py, docs/technique-destructive-guard.md,
# "Platform"): its tests are now skipped on Windows with an explicit reason, which the Windows workflow allows. Nothing is listed here any more.
